query: SELECT e.nome, e.slug, c.id, c.nome as categoriaNome, c.ordem FROM empresas e LEFT JOIN categorias c ON c.empresaSlug = e.slug AND c.tenantId = e.tenantId WHERE e.slug LIKE '%seraphine%' OR e.nome LIKE '%seraphine%' ORDER BY e.nome, c.ordem;
